faq.question: Can wooktools make private-label box cutters?

faq.answer: The right type depends on target users. Warehouse buyers may prefer safety or heavy-duty cutters, retail channels may prefer folding or snap-off models, and refill programs may need matching replacement blade packs.

faq.question: What packaging options are available?
faq.answer: Common options include blister card, hang card, color box, display box, replacement blade pack, barcode label, carton mark, inner carton, and export carton.

faq.question: What information helps wooktools quote faster?
faq.answer: Send blade format, handle material, logo file, color reference, packaging style, quantity, barcode needs, target market, and delivery schedule.

faq.question: How are box cutter quality risks controlled?
faq.answer: Common checks include blade sharpness, lock function, blade fit, folding or sliding action, handle assembly, safety function, packaging artwork, barcode, and carton condition.
